title: PCH thermal device, ACPI thermal zone and DIMM temperatures never reach the OS
description: The OS never receives three sensors: the PCH thermal device is hidden (1AB=0, no 00:1f.6), there is no ACPI thermal zone, and DIMM temperatures exist only in iMC CSRs. The capture reads 0x150/0x154/0x158 on ff:14.0/.1 and ff:17.0/.1 as DIMMTEMPSTAT; slot 0 shows 54 to 57 and empty slots 85. nct6775 is not loaded, and the live DSDT leaves A20+ unclaimed.
not_established: Binding nct6775 is untested. The DIMMTEMPSTAT offsets are not yet checked against the Intel datasheet.
remediation: Setup change for the PCH device. No binary fix justified, C3.
